period: since 1935 (incorporation dates) · the current state, not a history
cadence: source: nightly (resource modified 2026-10-18 01:22) · PROPX: every working day (dd-sync.yml)
identifiers: company number (9 digits) — exact; name — unique per the Registrar (an identical name with a legal-form marker names one company) but spelled with ~, hyphens, dots and extra spaces that differ from the tender / lottery strings
joinKey: developer canonical name → normalized legal name (quotes / dots / hyphens / spacing unified) → STRONG MATCH when exactly one row; company number only when a PROPX source or the user carries it (none today) → VERIFIED
why: exact official identifier (company number) for every legal company; registered status, type and breach flag by that key; name-only resolution is explicit (STRONG / POSSIBLE / AMBIGUOUS / UNRESOLVED), never VERIFIED
limitations: no PROPX source carries a company number — a developer is matched by its registered name only: STRONG MATCH at best, never VERIFIED
no ownership data: parent / subsidiary / SPV / guarantor relationships are NOT resolvable from this source
a struck-off and an active company may share a normalized name — AMBIGUOUS, never picked
"מפרה" (breach) is a filing-duty flag of the Registrar; it is not distress, not insolvency
the registry carries the current state only: no status history (the filings register carries recent changes)
evidence: run 39114805844 lane companies: head 5 rows, vocabulary over 2,000 rows, 10 known developers looked up (fulltext hits for 9; exact hits only after the ~ normalization — run 39115194781 lane insolvency set registry: by number 7/7, by ~-name 4/7 — the other 3 differ by a hyphen, a dot or spacing)
